chunks.heading: When an address can be changed
chunks.document_text:
# Address Changes

## When an address can be changed

The shipping address on an order can be changed **only while the order is
unfulfilled**. Once an order has shipped, the address can no longer be
changed; if delivery fails, the package returns to us and we will contact
you.

chunks.heading: How to request a change
chunks.document_text:
# Address Changes

## How to request a change

Contact support with your order number and the complete new address (street,
city, state, ZIP, country). After a team member reviews and approves the
request, we apply the change and confirm it back to you.

chunks.heading: Refused or undeliverable packages
chunks.document_text:
# Address Changes

## Refused or undeliverable packages

Packages returned to us as undeliverable are refunded minus the original
shipping cost once they arrive back at our warehouse.

chunks.heading: When an order can be cancelled
chunks.document_text:
# Cancellations

## When an order can be cancelled

An order can be cancelled **only while it is unfulfilled** — that is, before
it has shipped. Once an order has shipped (fully or partially), it can no
longer be cancelled; use a return and refund instead once it arrives.

chunks.heading: What happens on cancellation
chunks.document_text:
# Cancellations

## What happens on cancellation

Cancelled orders are refunded in full to the original payment method, and any
reserved stock is released. You will not be charged anything for a cancelled
order.

chunks.heading: How to cancel
chunks.document_text:
# Cancellations

## How to cancel

Reply to your order confirmation or contact support with your order number
(for example `#1036`). Cancellation requests are reviewed by our team before
they are carried out.

chunks.heading: Refund window
chunks.document_text:
# Returns & Refunds

## Refund window

We accept refund requests within **30 days of the order date**. Requests made
after 30 days cannot be refunded through support; day 30 itself still
qualifies.

chunks.heading: What you get back
chunks.document_text:
# Returns & Refunds

## What you get back

Approved refunds return the **full order amount to the original payment
method**. Refunds are processed as soon as a member of our team approves the
request; your bank may take 3–5 business days to show the money.

chunks.heading: High-value orders
chunks.document_text:
# Returns & Refunds

## High-value orders

Refunds over **$100** receive an additional review by our team before they are
processed. This can add up to one business day.

chunks.heading: Condition of items
chunks.document_text:
# Returns & Refunds

## Condition of items

Items should be unused and in their original packaging. If an item arrived
damaged or defective, mention it in your request — damaged-on-arrival items
are always refundable within the 30-day window.

chunks.heading: Processing time
chunks.document_text:
# Shipping

## Processing time

Orders are processed within **1–2 business days**. You will receive a
confirmation email with tracking once your order ships.

chunks.heading: Delivery estimates
chunks.document_text:
# Shipping

## Delivery estimates

- United States: 3–7 business days after processing.
- We currently ship within the United States only.

chunks.heading: Tracking
chunks.document_text:
# Shipping

## Tracking

Every shipment includes a tracking number, sent by email when the order
leaves our warehouse. If your tracking has not updated for more than 5
business days, contact support with your order number.

chunks.heading: Lost or delayed packages
chunks.document_text:
# Shipping

## Lost or delayed packages

If a package is marked delivered but has not arrived, or is more than 10
business days late, contact support — we will investigate with the carrier
and arrange a replacement or refund where appropriate.

chunks.heading: Coverage
chunks.document_text:
# Warranty

## Coverage

All products carry a **12-month warranty** against manufacturing defects,
counted from the delivery date. Kitchen appliances (for example espresso
machines) are covered for the same 12 months.

chunks.heading: What is covered
chunks.document_text:
# Warranty

## What is covered

- Defects in materials or workmanship.
- Products that stop working under normal home use.

chunks.heading: What is not covered
chunks.document_text:
# Warranty

## What is not covered

- Normal wear and tear (scratches, fading).
- Damage from misuse, accidents, or unauthorized repair.
- Consumable parts such as filters.

chunks.heading: How to claim
chunks.document_text:
# Warranty

## How to claim

Contact support with your order number, a short description of the problem,
and a photo if possible. Valid claims receive a replacement, or a refund if
the product is no longer available.

Negative cases have no answer in this corpus. Chinese cases are a separate paired language stress test, never pooled with English scores.
